doc.title: Carter Benny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Straightening out the Wilberforce and Charlie Johnson chronology
summary: Berger and Carter reconstruct the order of his two Wilberforce periods and his time with Charlie Johnson.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: Well, I just wanted to try and straighten out the chronology of this, because it’s kind of confusing to me.

It seems there may have been two periods when you may have been associated with Wilberforce, with the Collegians. Is that possible? Like in 1926, or in 1925, you went to Pittsburgh, and you met Horace. He invited you to join, to come to . . . what was the town? Is it Xenia, Ohio?
Then you went there, and I believe you must have gone back to New York and then played with Charlie Johnson in the interim.
Yeah, it certainly is possible, and probable. Yes.
Then I think you went back with Horace and the Collegians on this tour, which ended up electing you leader, and then ended up in 1928 at the Savoy Ballroom.
I think that must have been what happened.
Yes, I think that’s right. I am, you know . . . my memory isn’t what it used to be. It never was that good, but, you know.

You did all these things. There’s no reason why you have to remember precisely what came in what order. But I think that makes sense as far as . . . because in between you had a fairly long tenure with Charlie Johnson, which . . .
